request.raw_text: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.
action_words: Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one
reference_geometry_words: the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part

aim.primary_aim: Produce a single unified body comprising the existing part and its counterpart reflected across the plane at the non-rounded end.

functional_design_intentions.name: Unified body
functional_design_intentions.description: The existing part and its reflected counterpart shall form one body rather than separate bodies.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: A counterpart of the existing part reflected across the plane lying on its non-rounded end

required_relationships.reference: the plane lying on the non-rounded end of the existing part

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: The final geometry comprising the existing part and its reflected counterpart

required_relationships.reference: the reflected counterpart identified by T01

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Retain the existing part geometry as one constituent of the final unified body, except where continuity with the reflected counterpart necessarily affects their shared interface.

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: Non-targeted geometry and details of the existing part
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve all non-targeted dimensions, shapes, and details without unrelated changes.

geometry.description: Geometry corresponding to the existing part exists on the opposite side of the plane at the non-rounded end, with reflective symmetry about that plane.

relationships.reference: the plane lying on the non-rounded end of the existing part

geometry.description: The existing part and its reflected counterpart constitute one unified body.

relationships.reference: the existing part and the reflected counterpart identified by T01

functions.name: Unified body
functions.description: The reflected and existing portions function as a single body.

validation_criteria.description: A reflected counterpart of the existing part is present across the plane lying on the non-rounded end.
The existing part and its counterpart are reflectively symmetric about the referenced end plane.
The final model contains exactly one unified body comprising both the existing and reflected portions.
The existing and reflected portions constitute a single body rather than separate bodies.
The existing part and its non-targeted dimensions, shapes, and details remain present without unrelated changes, apart from the shared interface required by the unified result.

unresolved_requirements.description: No model identifier is supplied for the non-rounded end or for its associated plane.
candidate_interpretations: A plane coincident with the planar surface at the non-rounded end
A reference plane located at and aligned with the non-rounded end

unresolved_requirements.description: If the part has more than one end that could be considered non-rounded, the request does not distinguish which one defines the symmetry plane.
candidate_interpretations: The only planar, non-rounded terminal end
One of multiple non-rounded terminal ends
